overall: Claude reviewed exact clean HEAD 594dad716fe4f00ea90692013d8167144b21c457, verified the round-six evidence commit, and independently reproduced both newly identified proof-identity defects. It found 78 of 469 tracked files whose clean Windows checkout bytes differed from committed blobs, confirmed git archive and fresh_proof_root use committed bytes, and confirmed v1 also hashed platform working-tree modes. It audited every tasks.md consumer and found checkbox state drives lifecycle accounting, Stop, verification, and archive gates rather than command, test, or source selection; task text and ordering remain behavior-relevant. It validated the proposed canonical task grammar against all 137 current marker lines with no legacy/canonical divergence. The blob-sourced, versioned, domain-separated v2 fingerprint and exact active-packet task dual projection were approved before candidate freeze, subject to the recorded implementation requirements.
gaps: The consumer inventory must include packet_guard's packet-existence dependency and check_sync's raw task-template parity.
Status-only changes can alter Stop and archive outcomes without changing the executable digest, which must be stated explicitly.
BOM or CR task bytes must produce an explicit projection-declined diagnostic rather than a silent or aborting failure.
Only the exact target packet tasks.md is projected, so status changes in other packets remain conservatively executable.
Proof materialization must remain byte- and path-equal to the committed Git tree if export attributes or unsupported tracked types appear later.
risks: Record-level fingerprint_version checks are required in addition to hash-domain prefixes.
Projection failure must fall back to hashing the complete tasks file as executable rather than aborting fingerprint computation.
The v2 digest describes the committed proof candidate, not checkout bytes.
The grammar audit proves current-corpus agreement but future parser changes can drift without pinned two-way tests.
V1 proof records intentionally become non-reusable after migration.
required_changes: Land committed-blob sourcing with or before task projection.
Define projection failure as executable-only fallback with a named diagnostic.
Store and enforce fingerprint_version in reusable and final proof records.
Require proof archive paths, bytes, and relevant modes to match the committed Git tree.
Project only the exact active packet tasks path and prove task templates remain executable.
Document packet_guard, check_sync, task-text and ordering consumers.
State that governance state may change while executable identity remains stable.
